summary: Iteration 4 tests all P0 hardening + target-margin auto-suggest + HPP sub-recipe pct_material fix + S3 upload 503 + strict CORS. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py with 11 pytest cases — ALL PASS (100%). Regression /app/backend/tests/test_setup_e2e.py still 8/8 PASS. Frontend Playwright verified on public URL: login OK, /resep shows 'Harga Saran' column with data-testid recipe-suggested-price displaying 'Rp X @30%' badge; recipe editor exposes recipe-target-margin-input (hint 'Kosong = pakai default usaha 30%'), target-margin-box updates live from 30% default (Rp 500 rounded) to 50% override (Rp 700 rounded) when input filled; apply-suggested-price-btn fills recipe-selling-price-input with 700; recipe-save-btn present. /hpp page loads with target-margin-box functionality (verified via HPP report which shows saved sub-recipe HPP Rp 11 and parent HPP Rp 2.550 confirming pct_material fix). /produk (products) 'Tambah' dialog shows exact required text 'Upload foto nonaktif — penyimpanan file (S3/R2) belum dikonfigurasi di server.' under data-testid=products-photo-disabled. document.title == 'Keuangan & HPP UMKM'; no external emergent/posthog scripts (only same-domain overlay recorder & cloudflareinsights beacon which are infrastructure, not tracked in requirements). Routes /, /penjualan, /produksi, /laporan/hpp load without page errors. Backend behaviour verified: (a) recipe without target_margin gets business default (30) with correct suggested_price = hpp/0.7, rounded ceil to Rp100, suggested_profit_per_unit, string suggestion_note; (b) target_margin=50 → suggested = hpp/0.5; (c) target_margin=100 and -1 both return 400 'Target margin harus antara 0 dan 99,99%'; (d) business PUT target_margin=40 → recipes without override reflect 40 in summary, override recipe keeps its 50 (business reset to 30 after); (e) POST /api/hpp/calculate uses business default 30 when omitted, uses 25 when supplied, computes suggested_price = hpp/0.75; POST /api/hpp/calculations saves with suggested_price in result; (f) SUB recipe pct_material fix: sub yield 1000g with material A 1000g@10=10000 + 10% overhead=1000 gives sub hpp_per_unit=11; PARENT with 500g sub + 1000g B → parent hpp=2550; POST /api/production batch 1 qty 10 stores hpp_per_unit=2550 and overhead_total=500 (NOT 2500 — bug fixed as expected); (g) POST /api/upload → 503 with 'S3_BUCKET' in detail; (h) GET /api/meta → storage_enabled=false; (i) OPTIONS preflight with Origin http://localhost:3000 echoes access-control-allow-origin, evil.com is not echoed.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.storage_config() re-reads env on every call; fine but if env is set later it correctly refreshes since _client is only cached on first success — acceptable.

settings_router.BusinessIn.target_margin has no numeric validation (any float accepted); invalid values (e.g., 150 or -5) are stored on business, then recipes.list_recipes calls suggest_price which safely returns suggestion_note='Target margin harus antara 0 dan 99,99%' — but /api/business PUT itself does NOT reject invalid margins. Consider validating 0 <= target_margin < 100 in update_business, mirroring recipe validation for consistency.

core.recipe_cost passes target_margin from recipe override without re-validating range; validate_recipe blocks it on create/update but if a legacy recipe has out-of-range target_margin (from restore/import) it will silently show note without a suggestion. Low risk given validation on write.

compute_hpp: profit and margin only computed when selling_price>0; but suggested_price is computed independently — good, but Recipes list summary omits selling_price context, so UI showing 'Rp X @30%' when a recipe has selling_price=0 is fine (matches design).

expand_items pct_material fix uses `await recipe_cost(bid, sub, depth + 1)` inside inner loop — every parent extra_cost row triggers a full recipe_cost DB round-trip. For deeply nested / many-extras recipes this is O(N*M) DB calls. Acceptable for UMKM scale but memoize sub_material_total per sub if scale grows.
settings_router.upload always reads the whole file into memory before size check; for a 5MB cap on UMKM this is fine, but consider streaming to abort early on giant uploads.
server.py CORS strictly reads os.environ['CORS_ORIGINS'] which will KeyError at import time if unset — good (fail-fast per P0), but consider printing a clear message so ops know the cause.
Frontend logs two 401s on initial page load (auth/me before token) — cosmetic, but hides real 401s from monitoring. Consider skipping auth/me when no token.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all target-margin flows + upload-disabled notice + all main routes)

HPP sub-recipe pct_material previously computed 10% against parent recipe material_total (giving overhead_total=2500 instead of 500 for the specified scenario); expand_items now correctly resolves sub-recipe's own material_total via recipe_cost recursion, yielding overhead_total=500 and unchanged parent hpp_per_unit=2550 as reflected in Laporan HPP screen.
